text:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY deploy queued: routing.policy.v2 + batch.window=16ms + request.timeout=4s. Canary 5% at 22:00 UTC today, change window 22:00-01:00 UTC. Rollout ID: rld-20260320-17. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/r/runbooks/config-rollout

maria (prod-eng): ack, will be by my desk at 21:45 to watch metrics. confirm pinned model-version for canary?

deploy-bot: Canary will use pinned runtime image: inference-runtime:2026.03.12-config-pin. No model change.

ryan (sre): add SLO alert thresholds to the rollout: error-rate > 1.5% sustained 3m OR median latency p95 +20% over baseline => auto-stop. I'll attach the quick query before canary.

june (eng-releases): noted. Canary plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 15m if healthy, then 100% ramp over 30m. We will keep batch.window=16ms only for canary nodes behind the new routing policy.

ben (infra): heads-up: autoscaler cooldown set to 120s during canary to avoid churn. Also, traffic-tier fallback is enabled to route to geo-fallback pool if we hit capacity issues.

martin (prod): customer-facing release notes: "Operational routing tweak to reduce tail latency for streaming endpoints; no model or API surface change." Can someone draft one-liner for release-log?

maria (prod-eng): "Config-only: routing and batching tweak to improve streaming tail latency; no model changes. Monitoring and rollback configured." happy with that?

ryan (sre): test queries to validate:
```
# p99 should not increase beyond 15% of baseline
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'
```

june (eng-releases): rollback playbook (condensed):
- manual stop: POST /rollouts/rld-20260320-17/stop (ops-only)
- auto-stop triggers from SLO alerts (ryan will watch)
- rollback command for infra: `k8s apply -f routing-policy-v1.yaml` -> then scale routing controller to 0/1 to flush.
- post-rollback: run smoke tests + canary-verification job (5m).

ben (infra): I'll pre-stage the v1 routing policy and a quick kubectl snippet in the runbook so rollback is one-liner.

martin (prod): set expectation to PLG channel once canary passes. If we stop mid-ramp, we should send short note: "Rolling back routing/batching change due to elevated errors, continuing investigation."

maria (prod-eng): small check: are we also enabling kv-cache pinning for the canary? we don't want cache cold-starts to bias latency.

june (eng-releases): good catch — kv-cache pinning = true for canary instances. Added to rollout config.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 22:00 UTC. rld-20260320-17 -> group: canary-5. Logging to: https://dashboard.redwood/rollouts/rld-20260320-17

ryan (sre): watching metrics. baseline p95 180ms; alert if >220ms.

maria (prod-eng): smoke ok on a few endpoints. p50 looks better.

ben (infra): infra healthy, no extra OOMs or CPU spikes.

june (eng-releases): holding at 5% for 15m, will post an update at 22:15 UTC to move to 25% if green.

martin (prod): release-note one-liner approved. I'm drafting the public blurb.

ryan (sre): after 10m p95 is 190ms, p99 stable. no error spikes. continuing watch.

maria (prod-eng): +1 :thumbsup: move to 25% when you see green.

june (eng-releases): ramping to 25% now (22:16 UTC). reminder: autoscaler cooldown 120s, watch for QPS ripples.

deploy-bot: ramp step complete -> 25%. next step: 100% over 30m if healthy.

ryan (sre): seeing transient queue depth on a couple canary nodes, but no error rate increase. holding for 10m then decide.

ben (infra): increased routing controller replicas by +1 in canary group to smooth.

maria (prod-eng): holding. if anything looks off we do immediate stop.

june (eng-releases): proceeding with final ramp in 10m if steady. Otherwise we'll abort and run rollback.

martin (prod): thanks all. I'll post the internal summary after final ramp.

deploy-bot: [automated note] If rollout aborted: attach reason and `rollout_id` to incident ticket.

june (eng-releases): final update: ramp to 100% completed at 22:55 UTC, metrics within thresholds. Closing roll-out. Will create formal release note and tag the config commit: `git.sha: a1b2c3f-config-route-v2`.

maria (prod-eng): great ship :tada: — will leave monitoring on for next 24h and then mark as stable.

ryan (sre): will retain enhanced tracing for 6h. set alerts back to normal after 3h if stable.

ben (infra): prepped postmortem template in case anything crops up.

martin (prod): publishing brief note to PLG channel now. Congrats team.
